## Scorpion Demon (Gharros) (CR 14)

**XP** 36,400  
CE Large outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +27  

**Defense**

 **AC** 29, touch 14, flat-footed 24 (+1 dodge, +4 Dex, +15 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 320 (16d10+160)  
**Fort** +20, **Ref** +14, **Will** +9  
**DR** 15/cold iron and good; **Immune** electricity, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10, fire 10; **SR** 25  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** battleaxe +25/+20/+15/+10 (2d6+10/19–20/x3) or battleaxe +25 (2d6+10/19–20/x3), 2 stings +26 (1d8+10/19–20 plus poison)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th)  

 At will—darkness, desecrate, detect good, detect magic, mirror image, telekinesis (DC 20), greater teleport (self plus 50 pounds of objects only)  
1/day—summon (level 6, 4d10 dretches, 1d4 vrocks, or 1d2 glabrezus 50%; or 1 gharros 20%)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 31, **Dex** 18, **Con** 30, **Int** 18, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 20  
**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +27; **CMD** 42 (50 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Critical (battleaxe), Improved Critical (sting), Improved Initiative, Weapon Focus (sting), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +14, Bluff +24, Climb +29, Diplomacy +21, Escape Artist +20, Intimidate +24, Knowledge (planes) +20, Perception +27, Sense Motive +15, Spellcraft +14, Stealth +13, Survival +23; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common, plus any three; telepathy 100 ft.  
**Gear** battleaxe  

**Special Abilities**

 **Poison (Ex)** Sting—injury; *save* Fort DC 28; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d4 Con damage; *cure* 1 save.  

  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (Abyss)  
**Organization** solitary or pack (2–4)  
**Treasure** standard
